specification.objective: Run a reversible diagnostic isolation on the dedicated Kanban screen to determine whether the remaining wide-viewport paint offset originates inside KanbanBoardView or in the WorkspaceScaffold non-scrollable content path. Keep the dedicated route, contentScrollable=false shell mode, controller/API loading, sidebar, project selector, and renderer configuration unchanged while replacing only the mounted KanbanBoardView subtree with a simple bounded diagnostic probe.

requirements.statement: ProjectKanbanPage must remain a dedicated screen and must continue using WorkspaceScaffold with contentScrollable set to false.
The page must continue loading the selected project's Kanban board through the existing ProjectTasksController and must preserve the existing loading, unavailable-board, and kanbanError states.
When a board is loaded, ProjectKanbanPage must not construct KanbanBoardView during this diagnostic slice.
The loaded-board region must instead render a simple bounded diagnostic probe with no ListView, ReorderableListView, Draggable, DragTarget, overlay, or board-specific viewport subtree.

The diagnostic probe must expose deterministic text that confirms the board was loaded and reports the loaded column and card counts so a blank/offset render can be visually distinguished from a data-loading failure.
KanbanBoardView implementation, WorkspaceScaffold, renderer/bootstrap, controller, backend, API, authorization, persistence, and Kanban domain behavior must not be modified by this payload.
The locked Change Contract must be versioned at docs/contracts/project-kanban-board-subtree-isolation-v1.polis.json.

acceptance_criteria.statement: ProjectKanbanPage still contains contentScrollable: false and its existing project header and project selector while no longer constructing KanbanBoardView for a loaded board.
A loaded board renders a diagnostic marker with the text 'Diagnóstico do quadro' and deterministic column/card counts derived from the loaded KanbanBoard.
Frontend regression expectations assert that KanbanBoardView is absent while the diagnostic probe is present on wide and narrow viewports.
No file outside ProjectKanbanPage, its widget test, and the locked contract is changed.

invariants.statement: The dedicated Kanban navigation destination and ProjectKanbanPage lifecycle remain intact.
ProjectTasksController continues to fetch auth context, projects, project-scoped data, and Kanban exactly as before this slice.
The existing KanbanBoardView source remains untouched and can be remounted in a later slice after the paint-offset source is identified.
The Firefox CPU-only bootstrap workaround remains absent.

forbidden_states.statement: ProjectKanbanPage still constructs KanbanBoardView after a board is loaded.
The diagnostic changes WorkspaceScaffold, BackdropFilter, web bootstrap, KanbanBoardView, controller, backend, API, database, or authorization behavior.
The diagnostic probe introduces a scrollable, draggable, reorderable, or overlay-based widget tree.
The page stops loading the Kanban board, making the experiment unable to distinguish rendering from data-loading behavior.

inputs.statement: The published feature/tasks-kanban state at commit 6b513a2e4f591efafa6492718b8c556738dac602, where global lag is resolved but the dedicated Kanban screen still paints its content with an apparent sidebar-width horizontal offset.

outputs.statement: A diagnostic Kanban screen that preserves the exact shell/contentScrollable path and data loading while replacing the board widget subtree with a simple bounded probe.
A build suitable for deciding whether the paint offset persists without KanbanBoardView construction.

failure_semantics.statement: If ProjectKanbanPage still mounts KanbanBoardView, loses contentScrollable=false, omits the diagnostic marker/counts, or the regression expectation is absent, validation fails closed with project_kanban_board_subtree_isolation_missing.
Flutter/Dart tooling is unavailable in the artifact-production environment, so widget tests are included but must not be represented as executed here; structural POLIS validation remains mandatory.

argv: from pathlib import Path; import sys; p=Path('lib/features/projects/presentation/project_kanban_page.dart').read_text(); t=Path('test/features/projects/presentation/project_kanban_page_test.dart').read_text(); loaded=p[p.index('Widget _buildBoardContent'):p.index('Future<String?> _promptKanbanColumnName')]; ok=('contentScrollable: false' in p and 'KanbanBoardView(' not in loaded and "'Diagnóstico do quadro'" in loaded and "'Colunas carregadas: $columnCount'" in loaded and "'Cards carregados: $cardCount'" in loaded and 'Kanban rendering probe isolates board subtree' in t and 'find.byType(KanbanBoardView), findsNothing' in t); print('project_kanban_board_subtree_isolation_ok' if ok else 'project_kanban_board_subtree_isolation_missing'); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
